column1: # How auto captions write names and game terms, and the spelling to use instead.
# Read by cs2c/captions.py. Lowercase aliases match any case; an alias with capitals
# must match exactly. "write" empty: the entity's own name. Player and team aliases
# only apply on VODs where that team plays. Add misses from data/interim/captions/suggest.tsv.
